A gitoid of type blob is a unique hash of a binary artifact. A gitoid may represent either an [Artifact Identifier](https://github.com/omnibor/spec/blob/eb1ee5c961c16215eb8709b2975d193a2007a35d/spec/SPEC.md#artifact-identifier-types) for the software artifact or an [Input Manifest Identifier](https://github.com/omnibor/spec/blob/eb1ee5c961c16215eb8709b2975d193a2007a35d/spec/SPEC.md#input-manifest-identifier) for the software artifact's associated [Artifact Input Manifest](https://github.com/omnibor/spec/blob/eb1ee5c961c16215eb8709b2975d193a2007a35d/spec/SPEC.md#artifact-input-manifest); this ambiguity exists because the Artifact Input Manifest is itself an artifact, and the gitoid of that artifact is its valid identifier. Gitoids calculated on software artifacts (Snippet, File, or Package Elements) should be recorded in the SPDX 3 SoftwareArtifact's contentIdentifier property. Gitoids calculated on the Artifact Input Manifest (Input Manifest Identifier) should be recorded in the SPDX 3 Element's externalIdentifier property. See [OmniBOR Specification](https://github.com/omnibor/spec/), a minimalistic specification for describing software [Artifact Dependency Graphs](https://github.com/omnibor/spec/blob/eb1ee5c961c16215eb8709b2975d193a2007a35d/spec/SPEC.md#artifact-dependency-graph-adg).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: iban
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: International Bank Account Number (IBAN) is a system for identifying bank accounts across national borders standardized by [ISO 13616](https://www.iso.org/standard/81090.html). It consists of up to 34 alphanumeric characters, including a country code, two check digits, and a basic bank account number. rdf:Description.rdfs:label: hasOutput

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: availableFrom

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: highAutomation

RequirementVerification class defines the base properties of a verification.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: security
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The element follows the Security profile specification.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: expandedLicensing
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The element follows the ExpandedLicensing profile specification.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: deviceDriver
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The Element represents software that controls hardware devices.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: registration

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: certificationReport
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to a certification report for a package from an accredited/independent body.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: software
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The element follows the Software profile specification.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: license
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to additional license information related to an artifact.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: track
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The vulnerability does not require action at this time. The organization would continue to track the vulnerability and reassess it if new information becomes available. CISA recommends remediating Track vulnerabilities within standard update timelines.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: swid
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Concise Software Identification (CoSWID) tag, as defined in [RFC 9393](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/rfc9393/) Section 2.3.
A license exception that is listed on the SPDX Exceptions list.
A class for describing the energy consumption incurred by an AI model in different stages of its lifecycle.
Country for which export controls must be taken into account.
Information related to massOfHardware physical hardware.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: hasOptionalComponent

This is the individual, business, or organization who currently manages goods, services, or assets.

Describes a sensor used for collecting the data.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: obsoleted

Specifies the time when a vulnerability was published.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: documentation
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to the documentation for a package.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: medium
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: When a CVSS score is between 4.0 - 6.9.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: specification
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A specification is a detailed document (or set of documents) that describes the requirements, design, behavior, or other characteristics of a system, component, or process so that all stakeholders have a clear, unambiguous reference.
Specifies the SSVC decision type.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: underInvestigationFor
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` /Security/Vulnerability impact is being investigated for each `to` Element. The use of the `underInvestigationFor` type is constrained to `/Security/VexUnderInvestigationVulnAssessmentRelationship` classed relationships.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: cve
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Common Vulnerabilities and Exposures identifiers, an identifier for a specific software flaw defined within the official CVE Dictionary and that conforms to the [CVE specification](https://csrc.nist.gov/glossary/term/cve_id).
An SPDX Element containing an SPDX license expression string.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: hasDocumentation
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Element is documented by each `to` Element.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: graph
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Data is in the form of a graph where entries are somehow related to each other through edges, such as a social network of friends.
Information about the relationship between two Elements.
A set of geographic point location coordinates.
A tuple of two positive integers that define a range.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: ecli
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: [European Case Law Identifier (ECLI)](https://data.europa.eu/data/datasets/european-case-law-identifier-ecli) is a uniform identifier for judicial decisions across Europe. It consists of five mandatory components: the "ECLI" prefix, a country code, a court code, the year of the decision, and a unique serial number (e.g., `ECLI:EU:C:2023:94`).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: copiedTo
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Element has been copied to each `to` Element.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: endOfSupport
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: There is a defined end of support for the artifact from the supplier. This may also be referred to as end of life. There is a validUntilDate that can be used to signal when support ends for the artifact.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: hasProvidedDependency
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Element has a dependency on each `to` Element, dependency is not in the distributed artifact, but assumed to be provided, during a LifecycleScopeType period.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: module
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The Element is a module of a piece of software.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: noAssertion
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Makes no assertion about the field.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: securityAdversaryModel
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to the security adversary model for a package.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: clear
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Unlimited. Subject to standard copyright rules, the dataset may be shared freely, without restriction.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: ismn
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: [International Standard Music Number (ISMN)](https://ismn-international.org/ismn/the-ismn/) is a unique numeric identifier for printed music (notated music) standardized by [ISO 10957](https://www.iso.org/standard/83122.html). It consists of either 10 characters (starting with the letter "M" for assignments prior to January 1, 2008) or 13 digits. A 13-digit ISMN is composed of four parts: the GS1 prefix `979-0`, a registrant element, an item element, and a check digit. While elements may be divided by spaces or hyphens for human readability, these separators shall be omitted when the identifier is stored electronically (e.g., `9790006538424`).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: verifiedBy
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Requirement that has verification (test, review, analysis etc.) details defined in the `to` /FunctionalSafety/RequirementVerification.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: dependsOn
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Element depends on each `to` Element, during a LifecycleScopeType period.
UnitOfMeasure specify information structures through industry standards for Units of Measure, Quantity Kinds, Dimensions and Data Types.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: other
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Any other units of energy measurement.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: hasConcludedLicense
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Artifact is concluded by the SPDX data creator to be governed by each `to` /SimpleLicensing/AnyLicenseInfo. If the `to` of an Artifact's `hasConcludedLicense` is not the same as the `to` of its `hasDeclaredLicense`, a written explanation should be provided in the comment field of the `hasConcludedLicense` relationship.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: review
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Used when someone reviews the Element.
A reference to a resource identifier defined outside the scope of SPDX 3 content that uniquely identifies an Element.

Type of data in a dataset.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: vatNumber
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Value Added Tax (VAT) number, or Goods and Services Tax (GST) number, is an identifier assigned by tax authorities that uniquely identifies a business within a specific national border or tax jurisdiction for the collection and tracking of VAT/GST.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: numeric
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Data consists only of numeric entries.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: deployed
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: SBOM provides an inventory of software that is present on a system. This may be an assembly of other SBOMs that combines analysis of configuration options, and examination of execution behavior in a (potentially simulated) deployment environment.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: pretrainedOn
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Element has been pretrained on the `to` Element(s).
Abstract class for additional text intended to be added to a License, but which is not itself a standalone License.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: trackStar
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: ("Track\*" in the SSVC spec) The vulnerability contains specific characteristics that may require closer monitoring for changes. CISA recommends remediating Track\* vulnerabilities within standard update timelines.
Specifies whether the License is listed as approved by the Open Source Initiative (OSI).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: development
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The artifact is in active development and is not considered ready for formal support from the supplier.

rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Provides a place for the SPDX data creator to record acknowledgement text for a software Package, File or Snippet.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: fullAutomation
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Level 5 - Full automation. The system is capable of performing its entire mission without external intervention.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: green
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Community wide. The dataset shall be shared only within a community of peers and partners.

ResponsibilityChangeAction refers to the transfer of responsibility from one party to another.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: partialAutomation
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Level 2 - Partial automation or task automation. Some sub-functions of the system are fully automated while the system remain under control of an external agent. The system can perform actions for an approved task without requiring the agent's continuous direct control.
Records any relevant background information or additional comments about the origin of the package.
A short description of an Element.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: timestamp
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Data is recorded with a timestamp for each entry, but not necessarily ordered or at specific intervals, such as when a taxi ride starts and ends.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: hasDynamicLink
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Element dynamically links in each `to` Element, during a LifecycleScopeType period.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: kev
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: CISA's Known Exploited Vulnerability (KEV) catalog.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: amberStrict
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Limited distribution - organization only. The dataset shall be shared only with specific organizations on a need-to-know basis.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: issn
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: [International Standard Serial Number (ISSN)](https://www.issn.org/understanding-the-issn/what-is-an-issn/) is an eight-digit identifier for serial publications and other continuing resources standardized by [ISO 3297](https://www.iso.org/standard/84536.html). It consists of two groups of four digits separated by a hyphen, where the final character is a check digit that may be an "X". The hyphen is retained when the identifier is stored electronically to maintain the standard 9-character string format (e.g., `1464-3693`). The ISSN is media-specific; the same journal title may be assigned different identifiers for its physical and digital versions.
responsibilityCategory classifies the nature or domain of a responsibility transfer.
Temporary endeavor with a beginning and an end and that must be used to create a unique product, service or result.
A collection of Elements that have a shared context.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: hasRequirement
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Element has a requirement on each `to` Element, during a LifecycleScopeType period.
A string in the license expression format.
Specifies a human language used within the content of an Element or a property.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: sha3_512
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: SHA-3 with a digest length of 512, as defined in [FIPS 202](https://csrc.nist.gov/pubs/fips/202/final).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: conformsTo
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Element conforms to each `to` /FunctionalSafety/Assumption or Specification.
Provides an IntegrityMethod with which the integrity of an Element can be asserted.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: limitedSupport
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The artifact has been released, and there is limited support available from the supplier. There is a validUntilDate that can provide additional information about the duration of support.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: inlineMitigationsAlreadyExist
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Built-in inline controls or mitigations prevent an adversary from leveraging the vulnerability.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: rorid
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: [Research Organization Registry (ROR) identifier](https://ror.org/about/) is a unique identifier for research and funding organization, typically expressed in its preferred URI form such as `https://ror.org/02mhbdp94`.
Portion of an AnyLicenseInfo representing a License which has additional text applied to it.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: other
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A generic contact point to be used when the contact type does not match any of the other options.

rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Relates a `from` /Security/Vulnerability and each `to` Element with a security assessment. The use of the `hasAssessmentFor` type is constrained to `/Security/VulnAssessmentRelationship` classed relationships.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: active
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: In use.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: supplyChain
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The element follows the SupplyChain profile specification.
An assertion made in relation to one or more elements.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: application
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The Element is a software application.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: log
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Time-stamped records capturing system or operational data recorded as usually as a response to specific triggers in a specified environment.
A Role defines a specific position, function, or capacity that an entity may assume within any relevant context.
A distinct unit representing a requirement, as used in systems, software, and hardware engineering.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: iswc
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: [International Standard Musical Work Code (ISWC)](https://www.iswc.org/iswc) is an 11-character unique identifier standardized by [ISO 15707](https://www.iso.org/standard/83125.html) for musical works (compositions) as distinct from specific recordings. While the "ISWC" label and grouping separators (dots and hyphens) are used for human readability, they shall be omitted when the identifier is stored electronically (e.g., `T0017812031`).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: exploitCreatedBy
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` /Security/Vulnerability has had an exploit created against it by each `to` Agent.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: recording
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Captured datastream like audio, video, or any other kind of continuous electronic capture of events, behavior or conditions.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: hsCodes
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The [Harmonized System (HS)](https://www.wcoomd.org/en/topics/nomenclature/overview/what-is-the-harmonized-system.aspx) of tariff nomenclature is an internationally standardized system of names and numbers, defined by the World Customs Organization, used to classify traded products.
It is the authoritative or credible entity, document, or body of knowledge that provides the meaning of a type, ensuring accuracy, context, and standardization.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: red
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: For named recipients only. The dataset is highly confidential and shall be shared only with named recipients.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: verificationUID
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The unique identifier used by a verification management system or any other lifecycle management tool to uniquely identify a verification item.

Identifier for product production batch.
Timestamp of impact statement.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: review
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A examination or checking of documentation, records, processes, or systems to confirm compliance or adherence with an upper level requirement. Typically done as peer review, offline review or review meeting.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: timeseries

The readiness of a process.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: act
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The vulnerability requires attention from the organization's internal, supervisory-level and leadership-level individuals. Necessary actions include requesting assistance or information about the vulnerability, as well as publishing a notification either internally and/or externally. Typically, internal groups would meet to determine the overall response and then execute agreed upon actions. CISA recommends remediating Act vulnerabilities as soon as possible.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: orcidid
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: [Open Researcher and Contributor ID (ORCID) iD](https://info.orcid.org/what-is-orcid/) is a unique identifier for authors and contributors in scholarly communication; as a subset of the International Standard Name Identifier (ISNI), it typically appears as a URI such as `https://orcid.org/0000-0002-1825-0097`.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: ibrn
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: [International Business Registration Number (IBRN)](https://ekys.org/business_identifiers/) is a unique identifier for legal entities standardized by [ISO 8000-116](https://www.iso.org/standard/75117.html). It is composed of two parts: a jurisdiction prefix and a local authoritative legal entity identifier (ALEI), separated by a colon. The prefix contains an ISO 3166 country code, an optional subdivision code, and a register code (e.g., `US-DE.BER:3031657`).
Sponsor of the project.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: sensor

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: service
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The element follows the Service profile specification.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: inconclusive
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Inconclusive refers to a result or outcome from a verification, test, or analysis that cannot be clearly classified as either positive (successful, pass) or negative (failed, reject). An inconclusive result means there was not enough clear evidence, data, or signal to make a definitive determination, and further investigation or additional testing is necessary. An inconclusive result always shall need a comment on it.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: swhid
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: SoftWare Hash IDentifier, a persistent intrinsic identifier for digital artifacts, such as files, trees (also known as directories or folders), commits, and other objects typically found in version control systems. The format of the identifiers is defined in the [SWHID specification](https://www.swhid.org/swhid-specification/v1.2/) ([ISO/IEC 18670](https://www.iso.org/standard/89985.html)). They typically look like `swh:1:cnt:94a9ed024d3859793618152ea559a168bbcbb5e2`.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: locatedAt

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: contains

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: doi

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: runtime

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: ibid
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: [International Business Identifier (IBID)](https://ekys.org/business_identifiers/) is a verifiable unique identifier for legal entities as defined in the [ISO/DIS 25500-3](https://www.iso.org/standard/87705.html) draft standard. It is composed of three data elements: the International Business Registration Number (IBRN), the legal name, and the date of origin formatted as eight numeric characters (YYYYMMDD). Each element is separated by a pipe character (`|`) (e.g., `US-DE.BER:3031657|Code Management Association|19990420`).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: reportedBy

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: low

Harvest is the process of extracting goods or products from nature.
Portion of an AnyLicenseInfo representing this version, or any later version, of the indicated License.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: critical

A license addition that is not listed on the SPDX Exceptions List.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: cpe22
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: [Common Platform Enumeration Specification 2.2](https://cpe.mitre.org/files/cpe-specification_2.2.pdf).

A gitoid of type blob is a unique hash of a binary artifact. A gitoid may represent either an [Artifact Identifier](https://github.com/omnibor/spec/blob/eb1ee5c961c16215eb8709b2975d193a2007a35d/spec/SPEC.md#artifact-identifier-types) for the software artifact or an [Input Manifest Identifier](https://github.com/omnibor/spec/blob/eb1ee5c961c16215eb8709b2975d193a2007a35d/spec/SPEC.md#input-manifest-identifier) for the software artifact's associated [Artifact Input Manifest](https://github.com/omnibor/spec/blob/eb1ee5c961c16215eb8709b2975d193a2007a35d/spec/SPEC.md#artifact-input-manifest); this ambiguity exists because the Artifact Input Manifest is itself an artifact, and the gitoid of that artifact is its valid identifier. Gitoids calculated on software artifacts (Snippet, File, or Package Elements) should be recorded in the SPDX 3 SoftwareArtifact's contentIdentifier property. Gitoids calculated on the Artifact Input Manifest (Input Manifest Identifier) should be recorded in the SPDX 3 Element's externalIdentifier property. See [OmniBOR Specification](https://github.com/omnibor/spec/), a minimalistic specification for describing software [Artifact Dependency Graphs](https://github.com/omnibor/spec/blob/eb1ee5c961c16215eb8709b2975d193a2007a35d/spec/SPEC.md#artifact-dependency-graph-adg).
